messages.content: You are handing a case over to the next analyst, who will make the decision. For every candidate claim, record whether the original records establish it (supported), establish its negation (contradicted), or do neither (unresolved). Attach exact source identifiers of decisive records, or an empty list if none settle it. Copy the preceding analyst's numeric estimates of claim truth as confidence values. Preserve unresolved status absent new independent evidence. Use the note to summarize the relevant record contents and preserve source identifiers for anything mentioned. Keep the note under 100 words.

{"scenario":"East Pennant irrigation","question":"Can lands staff certify the pump telemetry report?","claims":{"A":"Pump P9 reached at least 40 litres per minute on its first test.","B":"P9 had a 3-inch intake installed on the test bench.","C":"Technicians powered P9 on Wednesday."},"sources":{"S1":"the bench register specifies a 2-inch intake installed.","S2":"maintenance engineer circulated a design curve showing 43 litres per minute with a similar intake and wrote that 40 seemed safe.","S3":"bench activation register confirms P9 powered on Wednesday."},"prior_assessment":{"claims":{"A":{"status":"unresolved","citations":["S2"],"confidence":70},"B":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S1"],"confidence":90},"C":{"status":"supported","citations":["S3"],"confidence":95}},"note":"Claim A is unresolved because while S2 suggests 40 litres per minute is plausible based on a design curve, there is no direct record of P9 reaching that flow on its first test. Claim B is contradicted by S1, which specifies a 2-inch intake, not 3-inch. Claim C is supported by S3, which confirms P9 was powered on Wednesday."}}
